name: ai-copilot-bridge
description: Copilot (GPT/Claude auto) + Local Ollama AI collaboration

aiCopilotBridge.ollama.model.description: Local Ollama model name. Run `ollama pull <model>` first.

aiCopilotBridge.ollama.timeout.description: Ollama request timeout in milliseconds. Increase for slow PCs.

aiCopilotBridge.ollama.askBeforeSkip.description: Ask before skipping Qwen when local AI times out (for slow PCs).

aiCopilotBridge.ollama.showThinking.description: Show the local model's thinking trace (qwen3 <think>) in chat. Full trace is always in the Output log.

aiCopilotBridge.ollama.thinkingCollapsed.description: Show Qwen thinking as a collapsed '+ Thinking' line with a button instead of an inline dump.

aiCopilotBridge.qwenToolsEnabled.description: Let Qwen use Copilot tools itself (agentic mode). Reads auto-run; writes/commands need Lead approval (and you, when Lead says so).

aiCopilotBridge.qwenMaxToolSteps.description: Max tool steps per Qwen agentic task.

aiCopilotBridge.qwenMaxTools.description: Max Copilot tools exposed to Qwen per task (small local models drown in too many).

aiCopilotBridge.qwenMaxTokensPerStep.description: Max output tokens per Qwen agentic step (bounds rambling on slow PCs; 0 = uncapped).

aiCopilotBridge.qwenAgentThink.description: Let Qwen think during agentic tool steps. Off = act immediately (recommended, Lead reviews everything); on = slower with visible reasoning.

aiCopilotBridge.enableTools.description: Allow the lead model to use native VS Code tools. Turn off if tool routing keeps failing.

aiCopilotBridge.maxRounds.description: Max lead-Qwen collaboration rounds per request.

chatParticipants.name: multi
chatParticipants.description: Lead AI (GPT/Claude auto) + Local AI collaboration

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
